settings.question: When will my order be dispatched?
settings.answer: Dispatch and delivery times depend on the item and your destination. Contact us before ordering if you need a piece by a specific date.

settings.question: Which size should I choose?
settings.answer: If you are unsure which size to choose, contact us with your usual size before ordering.

settings.question: How should I care for my piece?
settings.answer: Care depends on the material and finish of each piece. If you are unsure how to care for it, contact us before cleaning it.

settings.title: Still have a question?
settings.text: Our team is happy to help with anything not covered here.
